title: The Mental Game Stay Present (Chas McIvor)
style: country swing bluegrass banjo brass bongo fast beat 128bpm comedy dad voice spoken interjections southern drawl acoustic guitar
lyrics:
[Intro - Chas spoken]
I say son, the body knows the swing
The mind just gets in the way of the thing
Stay present, breathe, one shot at a time

[Verse 1]
Forget the last shot, good or bad, son
The next shot is the only one
Between shots breathe four counts in, four counts out
Walk to the ball calm, no doubt no shout

[Pre-Chorus]
One shot at a time, dont add up the score
Focus on the process, never the door
If you bogey the seventh, the eighth is fresh
Dont carry the past in your mental flesh

[Chorus]
The mental game stay present, son
One shot at a time, the work is done
Breathe in four, breathe out four, calm hands
The body knows, just trust where it lands

[Verse 2]
Nervous on the first tee, normal son
Box breathing four four four four, calm has won
Feet in the ground, eyes on the target
Trust the routine, the routine is the market

[Bridge - Chas spoken]
I say boy, the score adds up at the end
Dont count it on the way around the bend
One shot one shot one shot done
The round is eighteen ones, never one round won

[Chorus]
The mental game stay present, son
One shot at a time, the work is done
Breathe in four, breathe out four, calm hands
The body knows, just trust where it lands

[Outro]
Present, calm, breathe, swing
One shot the only thing
Forget the past, forget the score
Thats my boy, thats the door
